#!/bin/sh
# 仅在无磁盘四核实验客体采样，保留计数与原始事件，不改变时钟或调度策略。
set -eu
root=/sys/kernel/tracing
instance=$root/instances/sshpool_guest_timers
output=/tmp/ssi-timer-capture
[ "$(uname -r)" = 6.8.0-147-generic ]
[ "$(hostname)" = sshpool-ssi-guest ]
[ "$(nproc)" = 4 ]
grep -qw 'rdinit=/init' /proc/cmdline
case "${1:-}" in
start)
    if ! grep -q ' /sys/kernel/tracing tracefs ' /proc/mounts; then
        mount -t tracefs tracefs "$root"
    fi
    [ -z "$(ls -A "$root/instances")" ]
    [ -z "$(cat "$root/kprobe_events")" ]
    mode=${2:-timers}
    case "$mode" in timers|irq|ktime) ;; *) echo 'unknown capture mode' >&2; exit 2;; esac
    if [ "$mode" != timers ]; then
        if ! grep -q ' /sys/kernel/debug debugfs ' /proc/mounts; then
            mount -t debugfs debugfs /sys/kernel/debug
        fi
        [ "$(cat /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/enabled)" = 1 ]
        [ -z "$(cat /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/list)" ]
    fi
    mkdir "$output"
    echo "$mode" > "$output/mode"
    mkdir "$instance"
    echo 0 > "$instance/tracing_on"
    echo global > "$instance/trace_clock"
    echo 8192 > "$instance/buffer_size_kb"
    cat /proc/cmdline > "$output/cmdline"
    cat /proc/version > "$output/version"
    cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted > "$output/tainted"
    cat /proc/cpuinfo > "$output/cpuinfo"
    cat /sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource > "$output/clocksource"
    cat "$instance/trace_clock" > "$output/trace_clock"
    cat "$instance/buffer_size_kb" > "$output/buffer_size_kb"
    for event in timer/hrtimer_init timer/hrtimer_start timer/hrtimer_cancel timer/hrtimer_expire_entry timer/hrtimer_expire_exit sched/sched_switch sched/sched_waking sched/sched_wakeup workqueue/workqueue_execute_start workqueue/workqueue_execute_end irq_vectors/local_timer_entry irq_vectors/local_timer_exit; do
        name=${event##*/}
        cat "$instance/events/$event/format" > "$output/format-$name"
        case "$event" in
        sched/sched_switch) echo 'prev_comm == "ssi-clock" || next_comm == "ssi-clock"' > "$instance/events/$event/filter";;
        sched/sched_waking|sched/sched_wakeup) echo 'comm == "ssi-clock"' > "$instance/events/$event/filter";;
        esac
        cat "$instance/events/$event/filter" > "$output/filter-$name"
        echo 1 > "$instance/events/$event/enable"
    done
    if [ "$mode" != timers ]; then
        cat /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/enabled > "$output/kprobes-before"
        cat /proc/kallsyms > "$output/kallsyms"
        for symbol in ktime_get_update_offsets_now tick_sched_do_timer tick_sched_handle; do
            echo "p:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_enter $symbol" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
            echo "r128:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_exit $symbol" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        done
        if [ "$mode" = ktime ]; then
            # 偏移只对应本次哈希固定的 6.8 客体，避开高频 PAUSE 循环。
            grep -qx 'ffffffff81213bc0 T ktime_get_update_offsets_now' "$output/kallsyms"
            echo 'p:ssi_guest_irq/ktime_seq_even ktime_get_update_offsets_now+0x38 seq=%r13:u32' >> "$root/kprobe_events"
            echo 'p:ssi_guest_irq/ktime_clock_done ktime_get_update_offsets_now+0x4e' >> "$root/kprobe_events"
            echo 'p:ssi_guest_irq/ktime_seq_check ktime_get_update_offsets_now+0xda before=%r13:u32 after=%dx:u32' >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        fi
        # 仅使用已核对的客体 ELF 偏移，记录正常 tick 的写入临界区。
        grep -qx 'ffffffff81212a30 t timekeeping_advance' "$output/kallsyms"
        grep -qx 'ffffffff8401b4c0 b tk_core' "$output/kallsyms"
        echo 'p:ssi_guest_irq/tk_write_begin timekeeping_advance+0x2e3 seq=@0xffffffff8401b4c0:u32' >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        echo 'p:ssi_guest_irq/tk_update_done timekeeping_advance+0x2f2 seq=@0xffffffff8401b4c0:u32' >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        echo 'p:ssi_guest_irq/tk_write_end timekeeping_advance+0x30f seq=@0xffffffff8401b4c0:u32' >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        for event in "$instance"/events/ssi_guest_irq/*; do
            [ -d "$event" ] || continue
            name=${event##*/}
            cat "$event/format" > "$output/format-$name"
            cat "$event/filter" > "$output/filter-$name"
        done
        cat "$root/kprobe_events" > "$output/probes"
        cat "$root/kprobe_profile" > "$output/profile-before"
    fi
    echo 1 > "$instance/tracing_on"
    if [ "$mode" != timers ]; then
        echo 1 > "$instance/events/ssi_guest_irq/enable"
    fi
    echo guest_timer_begin > "$instance/trace_marker"
    echo GUEST_TIMER_TRACE_READY
    ;;
stop)
    [ -d "$output" ]
    [ -d "$instance" ]
    mode=$(cat "$output/mode")
    echo guest_timer_end > "$instance/trace_marker"
    if [ "$mode" != timers ]; then
        # 停用入口并等待同步后再冻结，避免清除事件标记期间漏记命中。
        echo 0 > /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/enabled
        cat /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/enabled > "$output/kprobes-disabled"
    fi
    echo 0 > "$instance/tracing_on"
    cat "$instance/trace" > "$output/trace"
    for cpu in "$instance"/per_cpu/cpu*; do
        cat "$cpu/stats" > "$output/stats-${cpu##*/}"
    done
    echo 0 > "$instance/events/enable"
    if [ "$mode" != timers ]; then
        cat "$root/kprobe_profile" > "$output/profile-after"
    fi
    rmdir "$instance"
    [ ! -e "$instance" ]
    if [ "$mode" != timers ]; then
        for symbol in ktime_get_update_offsets_now tick_sched_do_timer tick_sched_handle; do
            echo "-:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_enter" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
            echo "-:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_exit" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        done
        if [ "$mode" = ktime ]; then
            for name in ktime_seq_even ktime_clock_done ktime_seq_check; do
                echo "-:ssi_guest_irq/$name" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
            done
        fi
        for name in tk_write_begin tk_update_done tk_write_end; do
            echo "-:ssi_guest_irq/$name" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        done
        [ -z "$(cat "$root/kprobe_events")" ]
        [ -z "$(cat /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/list)" ]
        echo 1 > /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/enabled
        cat /sys/kernel/debug/kprobes/enabled > "$output/kprobes-restored"
    fi
    echo complete > "$output/cleanup"
    echo GUEST_TIMER_TRACE_STOPPED
    ;;
*) echo 'usage: trace-guest-timers.sh start [timers|irq|ktime] | stop' >&2; exit 2;;
esac

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import shlex
import threading
import select
import time

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--mode',choices=['control','pair'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--variant',choices=['baseline','adjust','sync'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--label',required=True)
parser.add_argument('--kernel',choices=['7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf29'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--qemu')
parser.add_argument('--qemu-sha')
args=parser.parse_args()
if bool(args.qemu)!=bool(args.qemu_sha): raise SystemExit('both qemu and qemu-sha required')
root=Path('/Users/zjarlin/.sshpool/ssi-lab')
prefix=root/'evidence'/args.label
if Path(str(prefix)+'-result.json').exists():
    raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite prior run')
config=Path(__file__).parent/'guest_ssh_config'
base=['ssh','-F',str(config),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=30','-o','ServerAliveInterval=15','-o','ServerAliveCountMax=3']
peers=[r['address'] for r in json.loads((Path(__file__).parent/'boot.json').read_text())]
nodes=range(2 if args.mode=='pair' else 1)
stop=threading.Event()
logs=[]
processes=[]
close_tracers=[]
results={'mode':args.mode,'variant':args.variant,'phases':{},'samples_errors':[]}
qemu_name='qemu-system-x86_64-clock-offset-1' if args.variant=='sync' else 'qemu-system-x86_64-unpin'
if args.qemu: qemu_name=args.qemu
expected_machines=['bed141ceb5a94840930beead90b4d3a8','97609053a4db470a8a9fd24d2d2af76b']
host_cursors={}
results['qemu']=qemu_name
results['qemu_sha256']=args.qemu_sha
started=time.monotonic()
def phase(name, command, timeout=180, stdin=None):
    captures=[]
    print(f'phase={name} start elapsed={time.monotonic()-started:.1f}',flush=True)
    begin=time.monotonic()
    with open(str(prefix)+'-'+name+'.log','wb') as out:
        try:
            result=subprocess.run(command,input=stdin,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout)
            code=result.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            code=124
            out.write(b'\nHARNESS_TIMEOUT\n')
    phase_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-begin,3)
    for node,kind,tracer,err,remote_output in captures:
        tracer.stdin.write('stop\n');tracer.stdin.flush()
    for node,kind,tracer,err,remote_output in captures:
        status=tracer.wait(timeout=45);err.close()
        raw=subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo cat '+remote_output],timeout=60)
        Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-{kind}-trace.json').write_bytes(raw)
        if status:raise RuntimeError(f'trace node {node} kind {kind} exited {status}')
    results['phases'][name]={'exit':code,'seconds':phase_seconds}
    print(f'phase={name} exit={code} elapsed={time.monotonic()-started:.1f}',flush=True)
    return code

def sample():
    while not stop.is_set():
        for node in nodes:
            try:
                result=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','date -u +%FT%TZ; ps -eLo pid,tid,comm,time,stat | grep "CPU .*/KVM" || true; free -m'],capture_output=True,timeout=40)
                with open(f'{prefix}-node{node}-samples.log','ab') as out:
                    out.write(result.stdout+result.stderr)
                if result.returncode:
                    results['samples_errors'].append({'node':node,'exit':result.returncode})
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                results['samples_errors'].append({'node':node,'exit':124})
        stop.wait(20)

def start_close_trace():
    if args.mode != 'pair':
        return
    for node in nodes:
        listing=subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}', 'ps -eo pid=,comm='],text=True)
        pids=[int(line.split()[0]) for line in listing.splitlines() if line.split()[1].startswith('qemu-system-')]
        assert len(pids)==1,pids
        remote='/home/ubuntu/ssi/qemu-close-trace/'+args.label+f'-node{node}.json'
        error=Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-close-trace-stderr.log').open('x')
        command=['sudo','python3','/home/ubuntu/ssi/qemu-close-trace/trace-kernel-close.py','--pid',str(pids[0]),'--node',str(node),'--output',remote]
        proc=subprocess.Popen(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}',shlex.join(command)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=error,text=True)
        close_tracers.append((node,proc,error,remote))
        assert select.select([proc.stdout],[],[],15)[0],'close tracer readiness timeout'
        reply=json.loads(proc.stdout.readline());assert reply['ready'] and reply['pid']==pids[0]
    print('native close tracers ready on both nodes',flush=True)

for node in nodes:
    guard=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','cat /etc/machine-id'],capture_output=True,timeout=40,check=True)
    if guard.stdout.decode().strip()!=expected_machines[node]:
        raise SystemExit('Lab ownership guard failed')
    command='test "$(uname -r)" = 7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf5 && test -z "$(pgrep -x qemu-system-x86 || true)" && sha256sum /var/lib/sshpool/boot-pf29/vmlinuz-7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf5 ~/ssi/qemu-system-x86_64-unpin ~/ssi/guest-vmlinuz ~/ssi/guest-ssh-ubuntu-initramfs.cpio.gz ~/ssi/run-clock-node.sh'
    cursor=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo journalctl -k -b -n 0 --show-cursor --no-pager'],capture_output=True,timeout=40,check=True)
    host_cursors[node]=cursor.stdout.decode().split('-- cursor: ',1)[1].strip()
    Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-start-cursor.txt').write_text(host_cursors[node]+'\n')
    command='test -z "$(ss -H -tan \"( sport = :37710 or sport = :37711 or sport = :40000 or sport = :40001 or dport = :37710 or dport = :37711 or dport = :40000 or dport = :40001 )\")" && '+command
    command=command.replace('qemu-system-x86_64-unpin',qemu_name).replace('7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf5',args.kernel)
    result=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}',command],capture_output=True,timeout=40,check=True)
    Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-hashes.txt').write_bytes(result.stdout)
    expected=[json.loads((Path(__file__).parent.parent/'steal-time/pf29-build-hashes.json').read_text())['kernel'],
              args.qemu_sha,
              '41ba36d860aa0b0cd995f4ca8856d80249b244577e704929b55be13fbd1ebd2f',
              '87342480b6393c24c82aa72125ffb328ff5b9c32e4af24116365a37fb87e9861',
              'ae6f0cc156d6ee1da62f4b6b76a5ff34cb7d8d14e5128ba7538fe73f00f58c0f']
    if args.qemu_sha: expected[1]=args.qemu_sha
    if [line.split()[0] for line in result.stdout.decode().splitlines()]!=expected:
        raise SystemExit('Runtime hash mismatch')
for node in nodes:
    if args.mode=='pair':
        runner='run-clock-node.sh' if args.variant in ('adjust','sync') else 'run-node.sh'
        command=f'SSHPOOL_LAB_GLOBAL_CLOSE=1 QEMU=$HOME/ssi/{qemu_name} INITRAMFS=$HOME/ssi/guest-ssh-ubuntu-initramfs.cpio.gz SSH_PORT=22230 RUN_SECONDS=1800 bash ~/ssi/{runner} {node} {peers[0]} {peers[1]}'
    else:
        cpu='qemu64,-x2apic,+tsc-adjust,enforce' if args.variant in ('adjust','sync') else 'qemu64,-x2apic'
        smp='4,sockets=2,cores=2,threads=1' if args.variant in ('adjust','sync') else '4'
        command=f'exec timeout --kill-after=5 1800 ~/ssi/{qemu_name} -name sshpool-clock-control,debug-threads=on -machine pc,accel=kvm,kernel-irqchip=split -cpu {cpu} -smp {smp} -m 256 -nodefaults -display none -serial stdio -monitor none -no-reboot -L ~/ssi/pc-bios -kernel ~/ssi/guest-vmlinuz -initrd ~/ssi/guest-ssh-ubuntu-initramfs.cpio.gz -netdev user,id=sshpool,restrict=on,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:22230-:22 -device virtio-net-pci,disable-modern=on,vectors=0,netdev=sshpool,mac=52:54:00:53:53:01 -append "console=ttyS0 rdinit=/init nokaslr panic=10 nox2apic"'
    log=open(f'{prefix}-node{node}-qemu.log','wb')
    logs.append(log)
    err=open(f'{prefix}-node{node}-qemu-stderr.log','wb')
    logs.append(err)
    processes.append(subprocess.Popen(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','ulimit -c 0; '+command],stdout=log,stderr=err))
sampler=threading.Thread(target=sample,daemon=True)
sampler.start()
print('guest started',flush=True)
try:
    while time.monotonic()-started<800:
        serial=Path(f'{prefix}-node0-qemu.log').read_text(errors='replace')
        if 'Server listening on 0.0.0.0 port 22.' in serial:
            break
        if any(p.poll() is not None for p in processes):
            raise RuntimeError('QEMU exited during boot')
        time.sleep(3)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('Boot readiness timeout')

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import shlex
import threading
import select
import time

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--mode',choices=['control','pair'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--variant',choices=['baseline','adjust','sync'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--label',required=True)
parser.add_argument('--kernel',choices=['7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf29'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--qemu')
parser.add_argument('--qemu-sha')
args=parser.parse_args()
if bool(args.qemu)!=bool(args.qemu_sha): raise SystemExit('both qemu and qemu-sha required')
root=Path('/Users/zjarlin/.sshpool/ssi-lab')
prefix=root/'evidence'/args.label
if Path(str(prefix)+'-result.json').exists():
    raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite prior run')
config=Path(__file__).parent/'guest_ssh_config'
base=['ssh','-F',str(config),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=30','-o','ServerAliveInterval=15','-o','ServerAliveCountMax=3']
peers=[r['address'] for r in json.loads((Path(__file__).parent/'boot.json').read_text())]
nodes=range(2 if args.mode=='pair' else 1)
stop=threading.Event()
logs=[]
processes=[]
close_tracers=[]
results={'mode':args.mode,'variant':args.variant,'phases':{},'samples_errors':[]}
qemu_name='qemu-system-x86_64-clock-offset-1' if args.variant=='sync' else 'qemu-system-x86_64-unpin'
if args.qemu: qemu_name=args.qemu
expected_machines=['bed141ceb5a94840930beead90b4d3a8','97609053a4db470a8a9fd24d2d2af76b']
host_cursors={}
results['qemu']=qemu_name
results['qemu_sha256']=args.qemu_sha
started=time.monotonic()
def phase(name, command, timeout=180, stdin=None):
    captures=[]
    print(f'phase={name} start elapsed={time.monotonic()-started:.1f}',flush=True)
    begin=time.monotonic()
    with open(str(prefix)+'-'+name+'.log','wb') as out:
        try:
            result=subprocess.run(command,input=stdin,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout)
            code=result.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            code=124
            out.write(b'\nHARNESS_TIMEOUT\n')
    phase_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-begin,3)
    for node,kind,tracer,err,remote_output in captures:
        tracer.stdin.write('stop\n');tracer.stdin.flush()
    for node,kind,tracer,err,remote_output in captures:
        status=tracer.wait(timeout=45);err.close()
        raw=subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo cat '+remote_output],timeout=60)
        Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-{kind}-trace.json').write_bytes(raw)
        if status:raise RuntimeError(f'trace node {node} kind {kind} exited {status}')
    results['phases'][name]={'exit':code,'seconds':phase_seconds}
    print(f'phase={name} exit={code} elapsed={time.monotonic()-started:.1f}',flush=True)
    return code

def host_clock():
    # 客体握手后才启用宿主跟踪，避免将 SSH 等待占满有限缓冲区。
    command="echo CLOCK_HOST_READY; read go; sh -c 'echo TRACE_CLOCK_PID=$$; exec /tmp/ssi-clock --timer-intervals'"
    guest=subprocess.Popen(base+['ssi-guest',command],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    captures=[]
    begin=time.monotonic()
    try:
        assert select.select([guest.stdout],[],[],90)[0],'guest clock readiness expired'
        assert guest.stdout.readline().strip()=='CLOCK_HOST_READY','guest clock handshake failed'
        for node in nodes:
            listing=subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','ps -eo pid=,comm='],text=True)
            pids=[int(line.split()[0]) for line in listing.splitlines() if line.split()[1].startswith('qemu-system-')]
            assert len(pids)==1
            remote=f'/dev/shm/{args.label}-node{node}-host-trace.json'
            error=open(f'{prefix}-node{node}-host-trace-stderr.log','x')
            argv=['sudo','python3','/home/ubuntu/ssi/writer-host-trace/trace-host-writer.py','--attach-pid',str(pids[0]),'--node',str(node),'--require-kernel',args.kernel,'--output',remote]
            proc=subprocess.Popen(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}',shlex.join(argv)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=error,text=True)
            captures.append((node,proc,error,remote))
            assert select.select([proc.stdout],[],[],20)[0],'host tracer readiness expired'
            reply=json.loads(proc.stdout.readline());assert reply['op']=='trace_ready' and reply['node']==node
        print('host tracers ready; running one guest clock trial',flush=True)
        raw,error=guest.communicate(input='go\n',timeout=120)
        Path(str(prefix)+'-clock-host.log').write_text(raw+error)
        assert guest.returncode==0,'first clock trial failed'
    finally:
        if guest.poll() is None:
            guest.terminate()
            guest.communicate(timeout=30)
        for node,proc,error,remote in captures:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.stdin.write('stop\n');proc.stdin.flush()
        for node,proc,error,remote in captures:
            status=proc.wait(timeout=90);error.close()
            output=Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-host-trace.json')
            with output.open('xb') as target:
                subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo cat '+remote],stdout=target,check=True,timeout=120)
            digest=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            assert subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo sha256sum '+remote],text=True).split()[0]==digest
            subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo rm '+remote],check=True)
            assert status==0,'host tracer failed'
    print('host traces retrieved and tmpfs files removed',flush=True)
    phase('clock-tail',base+['ssi-guest',"for trial in 2 3 4 5 6; do sh -c 'echo TRACE_CLOCK_PID=$$; exec /tmp/ssi-clock --timer-intervals' || exit $?; done"],300)
    Path(str(prefix)+'-clock.log').write_text(Path(str(prefix)+'-clock-host.log').read_text()+Path(str(prefix)+'-clock-tail.log').read_text())
    results['phases']['clock']={'exit':results['phases']['clock-tail']['exit'],'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-begin,3)}

def sample():
    while not stop.is_set():
        for node in nodes:
            try:
                result=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','date -u +%FT%TZ; ps -eLo pid,tid,comm,time,stat | grep "CPU .*/KVM" || true; free -m'],capture_output=True,timeout=40)
                with open(f'{prefix}-node{node}-samples.log','ab') as out:
                    out.write(result.stdout+result.stderr)
                if result.returncode:
                    results['samples_errors'].append({'node':node,'exit':result.returncode})

                results['samples_errors'].append({'node':node,'exit':124})
        stop.wait(20)

        return

        listing=subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}', 'ps -eo pid=,comm='],text=True)
        pids=[int(line.split()[0]) for line in listing.splitlines() if line.split()[1].startswith('qemu-system-')]
        assert len(pids)==1,pids
        remote='/home/ubuntu/ssi/qemu-close-trace/'+args.label+f'-node{node}.json'
        error=Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-close-trace-stderr.log').open('x')
        command=['sudo','python3','/home/ubuntu/ssi/qemu-close-trace/trace-kernel-close.py','--pid',str(pids[0]),'--node',str(node),'--output',remote]
        proc=subprocess.Popen(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}',shlex.join(command)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=error,text=True)
        close_tracers.append((node,proc,error,remote))
        assert select.select([proc.stdout],[],[],15)[0],'close tracer readiness timeout'
        reply=json.loads(proc.stdout.readline());assert reply['ready'] and reply['pid']==pids[0]
    print('native close tracers ready on both nodes',flush=True)

for node in nodes:
    guard=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','cat /etc/machine-id'],capture_output=True,timeout=40,check=True)
    if guard.stdout.decode().strip()!=expected_machines[node]:
        raise SystemExit('Lab ownership guard failed')
    command='test "$(uname -r)" = 7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf5 && test -z "$(pgrep -x qemu-system-x86 || true)" && sha256sum /var/lib/sshpool/boot-pf29/vmlinuz-7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf5 ~/ssi/qemu-system-x86_64-unpin ~/ssi/guest-vmlinuz ~/ssi/guest-ssh-ubuntu-initramfs.cpio.gz ~/ssi/run-clock-node.sh'
    cursor=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo journalctl -k -b -n 0 --show-cursor --no-pager'],capture_output=True,timeout=40,check=True)
    host_cursors[node]=cursor.stdout.decode().split('-- cursor: ',1)[1].strip()
    Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-start-cursor.txt').write_text(host_cursors[node]+'\n')
    command='test -z "$(ss -H -tan \"( sport = :37710 or sport = :37711 or sport = :40000 or sport = :40001 or dport = :37710 or dport = :37711 or dport = :40000 or dport = :40001 )\")" && '+command
    command=command.replace('qemu-system-x86_64-unpin',qemu_name).replace('7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf5',args.kernel)
    result=subprocess.run(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}',command],capture_output=True,timeout=40,check=True)
    Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-hashes.txt').write_bytes(result.stdout)
    expected=[json.loads((Path(__file__).parent.parent/'steal-time/pf29-build-hashes.json').read_text())['kernel'],
              args.qemu_sha,

              '87342480b6393c24c82aa72125ffb328ff5b9c32e4af24116365a37fb87e9861',

    if args.qemu_sha: expected[1]=args.qemu_sha

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""在独占实验 VM 记录 KVM 进出、宿主中断与调度；不改变抢占和中断配置。"""
import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import select
import sys
import time

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('scheduling_trace', Path(__file__).with_name('trace-dsm-scheduling.py'))
scheduling = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(scheduling)
trace = scheduling.trace

EVENTS = ['kvm/kvm_page_fault', 'kvm/kvm_entry', 'kvm/kvm_exit', 'kvm/kvm_vcpu_wakeup', 'kvm/kvm_wait_lapic_expire',
          'irq_vectors/local_timer_entry', 'irq_vectors/local_timer_exit',
          'irq_vectors/reschedule_entry', 'irq_vectors/reschedule_exit',
          'irq_vectors/call_function_entry', 'irq_vectors/call_function_exit',
          'irq_vectors/call_function_single_entry', 'irq_vectors/call_function_single_exit',
          'irq/irq_handler_entry', 'irq/irq_handler_exit', 'irq/softirq_entry', 'irq/softirq_exit',
          'sched/sched_switch', 'sched/sched_wakeup', 'sched/sched_migrate_task']


def heartbeat():
    return {'monotonic_ns': time.monotonic_ns(), 'raw_ns': time.clock_gettime_ns(time.CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW),
            'realtime_ns': time.time_ns(), 'stat': Path('/proc/stat').read_text(),
            'interrupts': Path('/proc/interrupts').read_text(), 'softirqs': Path('/proc/softirqs').read_text()}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--attach-pid', type=int, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--node', type=int, choices=[0, 1], required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--require-kernel', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if os.geteuid() != 0 or platform.machine() != 'x86_64' or platform.release() != args.require_kernel:
        parser.error('只在明确指定的 x86 实验内核以 root 运行')
    target = Path('/proc') / str(args.attach_pid)
    if not (target / 'comm').read_text().startswith('qemu-system-') or b'-name\x00sshpool-' not in (target / 'cmdline').read_bytes():
        parser.error('目标不是明确命名的 SSHPool QEMU')
    tids = {int(path.name) for path in (target / 'task').iterdir()}
    for path in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not path.name.isdecimal():
            continue
        try:
            name = (path / 'comm').read_text().strip()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        if name.startswith('qemu-system-') and int(path.name) != args.attach_pid:
            parser.error('节点上存在其他 QEMU')
        if name.startswith(('probe-dsm-', 'probe-pvclock')):
            parser.error('节点上存在其他探针')
        if name.startswith(('dsm-conn/', 'kvm-dsm/')):
            if name != f'kvm-dsm/{args.node}' and not name.startswith(f'dsm-conn/{args.node}:'):
                parser.error('DSM 线程归属不符')
            tids.add(int(path.name))
    tasks = {str(pid): scheduling.task_snapshot(pid) for pid in sorted(tids)}
    if sum(task['comm'].startswith('dsm-conn/') for task in tasks.values()) < 8:
        parser.error('DSM 尚未建立')
    root = Path('/sys/kernel/tracing')
    group = f'sshpool_residency_{os.getpid()}'
    instance = root / 'instances' / group
    for event in EVENTS:
        if not (root / 'events' / event / 'format').exists():
            parser.error('缺少事件 ' + event)
    if (root / 'kprobe_events').read_text().strip() or list((root / 'instances').iterdir()):
        parser.error('节点上已有函数探针，本实验只使用静态跟踪点')
    task_filter = ' || '.join(f'common_pid == {pid}' for pid in sorted(tids))
    result = {'node': args.node, 'kernel': platform.release(), 'qemu_pid': args.attach_pid,
              'tasks_before': tasks, 'errors': [], 'heartbeats': [],
              'preempt_mode': Path('/sys/kernel/debug/sched/preempt').read_text().strip(),
              'clocksource': Path('/sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource').read_text().strip(),
              'event_formats': {event: (root / 'events' / event / 'format').read_text() for event in EVENTS},
              'task_filter': task_filter,
              'vmx_preemption_timer': Path('/sys/module/kvm_intel/parameters/preemption_timer').read_text().strip()}
    with args.output.open('x') as output:
        try:
            instance.mkdir()
            trace.write(instance / 'tracing_on', '0')
            trace.write(instance / 'trace_clock', 'global')
            trace.write(instance / 'buffer_size_kb', '65536')
            result['trace_clock'] = (instance / 'trace_clock').read_text().strip()
            result['buffer_kib_per_cpu'] = int((instance / 'buffer_size_kb').read_text().strip())
            for event in EVENTS:
                path = instance / 'events' / event
                if event.startswith('kvm/'):
                    trace.write(path / 'filter', task_filter)
                trace.write(path / 'enable', '1')
            result['capture_started_ns'] = time.monotonic_ns()
            trace.write(instance / 'tracing_on', '1')
            print(json.dumps({'op': 'trace_ready', 'node': args.node}), flush=True)
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 360
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                result['heartbeats'].append(heartbeat())
                if not select.select([sys.stdin], [], [], .1)[0]:
                    continue
                if sys.stdin.readline() != 'stop\n':
                    raise ValueError('未收到明确停止命令')
                result['exit'] = 0
                break
            else:
                raise TimeoutError('测量窗口超时')
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            result['errors'].append(str(error))
        finally:
            output.write('{"trace":')
            try:
                if instance.exists():
                    trace.write(instance / 'tracing_on', '0')
                    result['capture_stopped_ns'] = time.monotonic_ns()
                    result['trace_stats'] = {cpu.name: (cpu / 'stats').read_text()
                                             for cpu in (instance / 'per_cpu').iterdir()}
                    with (instance / 'trace').open() as source:
                        scheduling.write_json_text(output, source)
                else:
                    output.write('""')
            finally:
                if instance.exists():
                    trace.write(instance / 'tracing_on', '0')
                    trace.write(instance / 'events/enable', '0')
                    instance.rmdir()
            result['trace_cleanup_complete'] = not instance.exists()
            result['tasks_after'] = {str(pid): scheduling.task_snapshot(pid) for pid in sorted(tids) if (Path('/proc') / str(pid)).exists()}
            for key, value in result.items():
                output.write(',' + json.dumps(key) + ':')
                json.dump(value, output)
            output.write('}\n')
    raise SystemExit(bool(result['errors']) or result.get('exit') != 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
